overview: Reduced Find Us to a single polished Leo benchmark: removed Sagittarius and the entire sky→paper transition, replaced Leo with the supplied definition/instance exactly, and raised star quality (diffraction spikes, independent twinkle, Regulus rose heart glow, name+subtitle hover). Completion now settles into a calm resting state with constellation, solid edges, atlas artwork (screen-blended, body gaps filled), and soft twinkle — no automatic next beat. Added onStarMemoryRequest placeholder for future per-star memory panels without building panel UI. Validated with unit tests, typecheck, production docker rebuild/deploy to memories.songara.uk/moment, and three visual review iterations with screenshots under docs/artifacts/moments/find-us/leo-polish-benchmark/.
executiveSummary: Leo-only Find Us is live as the polished interaction benchmark: supplied geometry, cinematic stars, Regulus as heart, calm rest after completion, and a clean hook for future star memories.
userVisibleChanges: Only Leo remains on /moment in production; Sagittarius and paper transition are gone
Stars use white cores, four-point spikes, soft bloom, and independent twinkle (calmer after discovery)
Regulus has a warmer rose/pink heart glow and remains the focal star
Hovering a discovered star shows Name + Subtitle (e.g. Regulus / Heart of the Lion)
After the last star, Leo stays on screen with artwork + label — peaceful rest, no paper fade
Leo atlas artwork is visible behind the stick figure with filled body patches
architectureChanges: FindUsMoment phases simplified to boot | opening | constellation | complete
Paper dissolve/flecks/closing-text path removed from runtime and styles
Constellation catalog exports Leo only; Sagittarius definition/asset removed
StarMemoryRequestPayload + onStarMemoryRequest / onStarPress placeholder for future memory panels
Atlas art uses mix-blend-mode: screen for dark-sky readability without changing supplied opacity
configurationChanges: find-us.config.json constellationInstances is Leo-only with supplied transform centre (41.75, 37.11) scale 1.31
glow.lineWidth tuned to 0.55 for solid resting edges
